easyPrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters, it and Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger.
Resolve the Sunstrike Legionnaire trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Restoration Angel's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Restoration Angel's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 4.
